description: Examon Marconi HPC Monitoring Snapshot is provided by CINECA research team. The Examon snapshot contains observations from a subset of Marconi supercomputer nodes at CINECA during January and May 2020. The provider identifies the monitoring system and the University of Bologna research work that assembled the data. Geographic context: site; Marconi, CINECA, Italy. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: not established on the reviewed page. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The record is a limited snapshot produced during a research internship; it does not cover all nodes or continuous years of operation. Potential simulation use: Calibrate workload, monitoring and resource-use models.
